sections.value: WHEREOF THE COUNTER-CLAIMANT CLAIMS AS FOLLOWS;

value:
Use this information to enhance the draft:
The role is 'Counter-Claimant & Defendant', use if not specify.

Counter-claim is usually direct, eg 'The counter-claimant admits paragraph 1,2 and 3 of the statement of claim.', 'The counter-claimant states in response to paragraph 3 of the statement of claim, that...', 'The counter-claimant denies paragraph 4 of the statement of claim.', 'The counter-claimant avers that...'.

Most of the times the last paragraph begins and ends this way, eg 'The counter-claimant states that he is not liable for the claims, as stated in the defendant's statement of claim and prays the court to dismiss the suit as being frivolous and baseless.'.

Additional information: {{information}}, 
The draft should be within 500-10000 words.

Use today's date, to fill the date section.
